title: Localization Program Manager
description: Position Overview We are seeking an experienced and technically minded Localization Program Manager (LPM) to design, establish, and scale an end-to-end global localization operation. In this role, you will own the operational framework, TMS architecture, vendor execution, and cross-functional alignment necessary to launch new international markets seamlessly. You will serve as the primary bridge between Product, Engineering, Design, Legal/Compliance, and external linguistic partners, ensuring the product and content scale globally without increasing operational drag or costs. The ideal candidate possesses deep hands-on expertise with CrowdIn Enterprise , direct experience configuring continuous localization (CI/CD) pipelines, and a strong background in defining governance models, SLAs, and terminology strategies in fast-moving product environments. Key Responsibilities Program Strategy & Governance Establish the overarching localization operating model, including program intake, prioritization frameworks, RACI matrices, SLAs, and escalation pathways. Define and track key program performance indicators (KPIs) covering turnaround times, quality scores, cost efficiency, and release gate readiness. Author and maintain reusable market-launch playbooks to streamline entry into subsequent target regions post-launch. 2. Technical Infrastructure & CrowdIn Operations Own the setup, project architecture, permission levels, and configuration of CrowdIn / CrowdIn Enterprise . Partner with Solutions Architects, Localization Engineers, and DevOps to configure file parsers, API endpoints, webhooks, and direct repository/CI-CD integrations (e.g., GitHub, GitLab, Figma). Set up automated QA rules, pre-translation workflows, pseudo-localization testing, and machine translation (MT) engine integrations within CrowdIn. 3. Linguistic & Asset Management Oversee the lifecycle of core linguistic assets, including translation memories (TM), glossaries, style guides, and terminology databases. Partner with Linguistic Leads and product teams to enforce internationalization (i18n) standards and string-externalization best practices. Coordinate in-context reviews (LQA), functional testing, and sign-offs for regulated or domain-specific content (e.g., fintech, legal, compliance). 4. Cross-Functional Alignment & Vendor Management Collaborate with Product Managers, Content Strategists, Design Leads, and Engineering to build localization into the core software delivery lifecycle. Build, negotiate, and manage direct external vendor models, agency partnerships, and direct freelance linguist networks. Drive hypercare support during new market launches, monitoring release readiness and resolving technical or linguistic bottlenecks in real time.

description: TITLE : Localization Quality Assurance Analyst I LOCATION : Madrid DEPT : Global Localization COMPANY : 2K (Take-Two Interactive) TYPE : Full-Time, onsite At 2K, we create some of the most iconic and culture-shaping video games in entertainment, including NBA® 2K , one of the top-selling franchises in the world, and legendary titles like BioShock® , Borderlands® , Mafia , Sid Meier's Civilization ® , and XCOM® , as well as fan favorites WWE® 2K , TopSpin® , and PGA TOUR® 2K . We build unforgettable experiences by pushing the boundaries of creativity, authenticity and innovation across every genre. Our portfolio is brought to life by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Visual Concepts, Firaxis Games, Hangar 13, Cat Daddy Games, 31st Union, Cloud Chamber, Gearbox, HB Studios, and 2K SportsLab create world-class experiences across platforms. But what truly powers 2K is our people. We believe the best ideas come from teams that feel empowered, supported, and inspired. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive workplace where people are encouraged to come as they are and do their best work. What We Need Love games? Love languages? As part of 2K's Global Loc 2.0 initiative, we're building a more embedded and quality-focused approach to localization—and LQA Analysts are at the heart of it. As an LQA Analyst I, you'll be among the first to experience our games in your native language and help shape how they resonate with players across the globe. This is an entry-level role perfect for linguistically sharp, detail-oriented professionals looking to break into games or localization. You'll test pre-release content for linguistic accuracy, cultural relevance, and UI functionality—while learning the tools, systems, and collaboration models that bring 2K's global experiences to life. What You'll Do Execute test passes on localized builds to verify linguistic, functional, and visual accuracy Identify and log localization bugs—ranging from translation issues to UI problems—using detailed, reproducible steps Ensure consistency in spelling, grammar, terminology, tone, variable usage, and cultural appropriateness Amend or propose edits and translations to objective linguistic issues directly in text management systems Analyze reported issues to identify potential root causes and flag patterns that may indicate systemic localization or i18n risks. Flag localization risks early in the development cycle, including potential issues with variables, UI constraints, or source text clarity Support glossary and style guide validation as part of broader quality review cycles Follow documented test plans and contribute to test case creation and improvement Evaluate localization quality against first-party standards, platform-holder terminology, and branding requirements Review localization tickets or player reports, helping reproduce and escalate verified issues Participate in LQA team standups, bug t
pain_points: No native QA, backlog of Arabic content
